| Name  = Golden Shrine
| Image = Event-GoldenShrine.png
}} {{Small Card Infobox|Regret}}
{{E|Golden Shrine}} is a {{QueryLink|Events|shrine:Yes|shrine Event}} encountered in all [[Acts]].

== Options ==
{{Frame|Pray}} {{TS|positive||Gain 100 Gold.}}

{{Frame|Desecrate}} {{TS|positive||Gain 275 Gold.}} {{TS|negative||Become Cursed -}} {{C|Regret}}.
* {{C|Regret}} - {{KW|Unplayable}}. At the end of your turn, lose HP equal to the number of cards in your hand.

{{Frame|Leave}} Nothing happens.

== Dialogue ==
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
Before you lies an elaborate shrine to an ancient spirit.
</div>

{{Frame|Pray}}
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
As your hand touches the shrine, {{TS|gold||gold}} rains from the ceiling {{TS||up|showering you in riches.}}
</div></blockquote>

{{Frame|Desecrate}}
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
Each time you strike the shrine, {{TS|gold||gold}} pours forth again and again! <br>

As you pocket the riches, something {{TS|negative||weighs heavily on you.}}
</div></blockquote>

{{Frame|Leave}}
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
You ignore the shrine.
</div></blockquote>
</blockquote>
